results.detail:
{"toast":"Advisory copied to the clipboard.","clip":"CONTINUUM — BURNING ACTIVITY ADVISORY
Generated 2026-11-03 · research prototype · NOT an official NASA product

AREA: Chilecito & Famatina Valley (Argentina)
CENTRE: -29.16°, -67.50° · 19,400 km²
RECORD: 2000-11-01 to 2026-11-02 · 9,498 harmonized daily values

STATUS: ELEVATED — 84th percentile for the first 2 days of November.
Current 2 vs. historical median 1 (2.00×).

LIVE WINDOW: 2026-10-26 to 2026-11-02; 27 VIIRS-equivalent detections across 7 active days.
Sensor calibration: MODIS → VIIRS ratio 12.88× (90% CI 12.49–13.28); the 2012 break in the raw record is 136%, reduced to -45% after harmonization.
Analog seasons: 2016 (75%), 2019 (63%), 2018 (59%). Median next-four-week departure +107%. Leave-one-out hit rate 65%.
Season: typical window 7 Aug–20 Oct, peak 14 Aug; current phase off-season, running behind of climatology (75% of expected to date).

WHAT WOULD CHANGE THE CALL:
• A shift in the live window outside the 12.5–13.3 calibration interval would widen the uncertainty and lower trust.
• Cloud cover or missed overpasses can hide fire; absence of detections is not absence of fire.
• This advisory ranks activity against the same area's own history. It does not model ignition, spread or suppression.

METHOD VERSION 0.1.0 · reference record calibrated to the live FIRMS window, not the official NASA archive.
Caveat: The latest days are provisional. Supports situational awareness; not a warning, dispatch or evacuation service."}
